name: The buildings of Macau seen across fields from a tree-lined lane
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view across open fields to the city of Macau taken from the path known as 'Love Lane'; an oil painting closely related to this drawing (with the addition of figures) was sold at Christie's, London, on 25 May 2023, lot 10.
